title: Check if a word is a Python keyword
description:
Write a function `is_python_keyword(word)` that returns whether `word` is a reserved Python keyword (like `if`, `for`, `class`), using the `keyword` module.

Python-Gym adaptation of source item 14 ('run help("keywords") to check for the Python reserved words') - `help()` prints to the console for a human to read, so it isn't something a hidden test can check. `keyword.iskeyword()` answers the same underlying question (is this name reserved?) as a real return value instead.

hints: Module to consider: keyword, specifically keyword.iskeyword()
The keyword module's iskeyword(name) checks a string against Python's exact reserved-word list (the same one help('keywords') prints) - it's a lookup, not a guess.
expected_behavior: Returns True if word is a reserved Python keyword, False otherwise.
